15 persons begin to work together on a job, but after some days 6 persons leave. As a result, the job which could have been completed in 42 days is completed in 54 days. After how many days from the commencement of the work did 6 persons leave?
solutionText: Total work = 15 × 42 = 630 person-days. Let 6 persons leave after x days. Then 15x + 9(54 − x) = 630. Therefore 6x = 144 and x = 24 days. Video: https://youtu.be/8zBE1a-fKJg?t=11007

questionText: A and B together can do a piece of work in 20 days. A worked for 15 days and left. B finished the remaining work alone in 42 days. In how many days could B finish the whole work alone?
solutionText: A and B complete 15/20 = 3/4 of the work in 15 days. Remaining work = 1/4. B completes this remaining 1/4 in 42 − 15 = 27 days. Therefore B alone completes the whole work in 27 × 4 = 108 days.
